marcadores.explicacao_original: The perineurial cells form a compact wrapping around fascicles. The cells of the perinerium are highly unique and contribute to the formation of the protective blood-nerve barrier. They are distinct from fibroblasts which can be found within the fascicle where the secrete collagen fibrils.
